title: Show how often each product is ordered
description: The storefront wants to show popular products. GET /api/products now includes `orderCount` for each product: its number of pending or paid orders. Includes a test and a README update.

comments.issue: It runs one count query per product (N+1), all at once through `Promise.all`, on a public route that lists every product; use one grouped query (`groupBy` on productId or a filtered `_count` include) instead.
